instruction: Write an XDP program that inspects network traffic and must restrict bidirectional sessions in BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'ip_pair_map' dropping when src-dst pair exceeds 50 packets. Forward all other packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define struct ip_pair with saddr and daddr fields
Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH map 'ip_pair_map' with key struct ip_pair and value __u64
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Lookup pair key and increment counter, dropping with XDP_DROP if count > 50
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
